subject: angol
title: My new smartphone
situation: You have just got a new smartphone. Your English friend, Jamie, wants to buy a new phone too and has asked you in an e-mail what yours is like. Write an e-mail to Jamie.
situationHu: Új okostelefonod van; angol barátod, Jamie is telefont venne, és megkérdezte, milyen a tiéd. Írj neki e-mailt.

points.text: describe your new phone (e.g. camera, battery, size)
say what you use it for most often
give Jamie a piece of advice about buying a phone

usefulPhrases.en: Guess what? I've got a new phone!
The camera is brilliant and the battery lasts all day.
usefulPhrases.hu: Szuper a kamerája, és egész nap bírja az akkumulátor.

usefulPhrases.en: to download apps / to take photos

modelAnswer.text:
Hi Jamie,

Thanks for your e-mail. You asked about my new phone – well, I love it! The camera is brilliant, especially at night, and the battery lasts all day. It's quite big, but it's light enough to carry in my pocket.

I mostly use it for taking photos and chatting with my friends, but I also listen to music on the bus every morning.

If I were you, I'd read some reviews online before buying one. And don't forget to check how much storage it has!

Speak soon,
Máté

pointsCovered.quote: The camera is brilliant, especially at night, and the battery lasts all day. It's quite big, but it's light enough to carry in my pocket.
I mostly use it for taking photos and chatting with my friends, but I also listen to music on the bus every morning.
If I were you, I'd read some reviews online before buying one.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a telefon leírása a feladatban felsorolt mindhárom szempontra kitér (kamera, akkumulátor, méret), utána a használat és egy (sőt két) tanács következik.
Szókincs: a technikához illő, de nem túl szakmai szavak (battery lasts all day, storage, reviews online), kevés ismétléssel.
Nyelvhelyesség: a tanács feltételes szerkezettel szól („If I were you, I'd …”), az „enough” helyes szórendje („light enough to …”) és a „before + -ing” is pontos.
Hangnem: baráti, közvetlen e-mail összevont alakokkal, „You asked about my new phone – well, I love it!” felütéssel és „Speak soon” elköszönéssel.
Érdemes megtanulni: „the battery lasts all day”, „I mostly use it for + -ing”, „If I were you, I'd …”, „don't forget to check …”.
